about: The AE ravager pack: CMT's prototype ravager from the stock-compatible source release of The Silent Cartographer: Evolved 1.4 (tags for the stock tool kit, no Open Sauce), set up as the latest-generation ravager is and then tuned for CE. Taken from the source: three bolts a pull (its 3-round burst) leaving one after another 4 ticks apart (7.5 a second), a pull every 0.77 s (0.5 s from a burst's last bolt to the next's first), no bloom, a lobbed 45 unit/s bolt under heavy gravity that bursts on whatever it hits (a hit and a small splash, x0.5 on shields for the splash), x2 on the head, hold to charge and release for one big bolt (a bigger hit and burst) that leaves a burning pool, a 1.4x zoom, its aim assist, a 3 s vent once overheated and a battery of 36 bolts; 4 bolts strip a full shield and 7 kill (the third pull), as in the source. Changed for CE: the damage brought to CE's 75 shield and 75 body (CE spills a stripping bolt's excess onto the body, the source does not, so the body multiplier is x0.8), the burst paced by the engine (pack behaviour 5, the RAVAGER profile in port/linux/game/ae_rifle_profiles.c, played by ae_burst_rifle.c: CE has no burst trigger; the tags' trigger fires one bolt a shot, the tap's first on the trigger's release as the stock plasma pistol's, and the engine fires the other two and holds the recovery; the bolts, heat, battery, zoom, aim assist, kick and the charged shot stay the tags'), the pool made of CMT's devourer pulses (a fixed spot burning 2.25 s, AE's numbers), one heat-loss rate (CE has no separate overheated rate), the stock assault rifle's melee. What an Xbox map needs (the models converted, the multipurpose maps' channels reordered, the high-resolution HUD made the Xbox's, an Ogg Vorbis sound re-encoded), its own look (CMT's spiker model, which it shares, under its own copies of the shaders and models naming CMT's spiker textures recoloured by ravager_art.py, look B3bd). make_pack.py runs it; the locations of the zip, the stock map and the programs are given on its command line.

the latest-gen ravager's setup (owner: start with how it is set up there, then tune for CE). Taken: three bolts a pull and a pull every 0.77 s (its 3-round burst at 7.5 a second and 0.5 s between bursts: CE has no burst trigger, so the trigger fires one bolt a shot at 7.5 a second and the engine's RAVAGER profile, pack behaviour 5, fires a tap's other two 4 ticks apart and holds a 12-tick recovery, the tap's first bolt leaving on the trigger's release), no bloom (no spread); hold to charge (0.75 s, CE's charging trigger as the stock plasma pistol's, CMT's devourer charge glow) and release for one charged bolt (the second trigger); its 1.4x zoom; its aim assist (4.5 degrees / 20 units, magnetism 6.75 / 24); a 3 s vent once overheated (its 0.325 a second while overheated, down to 0.015); a battery of 36 bolts (its 0.0278 a bolt, a charged bolt too: a pull's three 0.0833). For CE: one heat-loss rate only (CE has no separate overheated rate): 0.33 a second, a pull 0.38 (0.1267 a bolt) and a charged bolt 0.5 of heat, so 7 pulls back to back overheat it (6 did when a pull's three bolts left together: the heat now bleeds over a burst's 8 ticks); no misfire (CMT's 50% past 90% battery); the held weapon's collision and melee the stock assault rifle's, left to the map, as every pack weapon's

haptics (the done checklist's point 14): a hard short pulse on both motors with each bolt (three a pull, 4 ticks apart) (the carbine's pattern, heavier; CMT's on the low motor only); CMT's flash and view kick kept
the charged bolt's kick: a long heavy rumble on both motors and a bigger view kick than a pull's

the latest-gen bolt: 45 units a second (1.5 a tick), its gravity x4 of its 4.17 units a second squared (16.7), which is x5.2 of CE's 3.21: a lobbed bolt that drops about 1.6 units over 20 (its world unit taken as CE's: not measured), 200 units of range; it bursts on whatever it hits (every material's response detonate, CMT's disappear), its burst the splash effect

a bolt's hit: the latest-gen 30 (x1 on shields) brought to CE's 75 shield (30 x 75/140 = 16), x1 on a player's shield and x0.8 on the body, x2 on the head once the shield is down (CE's multiplayer headshot, as the source's x2); half CMT's plasma slow

a bolt's splash: the latest-gen 25 at the centre to 5 at 0.95 units (full inside 0.3), x0.5 on shields as its explosion type, brought to CE (13 to 2.6); x0.8 on the body. A bolt on a full player: 16 + 6.5 = 22.5 of shield, so 4 bolts strip a full shield (3 leave 7.5) and, with CE's spill of the 4th bolt onto the body, 3 more kill: 7 bolts, the third pull, as the source's 4 / 7
a bolt's burst: only its splash damage (CMT's devourer impact effect cut to one event and one part; the impact's look is the material's, as CMT's ravager has it)
the charged bolt: the bolt's flight (45 units a second, the same lob), its own hit and its burst with the lingering pool
the charged bolt's hit: the latest-gen 60 brought to CE (32), the bolt's multipliers and headshot

the charged burst: the latest-gen 90 at the centre to 20 at 2.5 units (full inside 0.6) brought to CE (48 to 10.7), x0.5 on shields and x0.8 on the body: a charged bolt on a full player takes 56 of its 75 shield (the source's 105 of 140)

the pool's burn, a pulse every 0.25 s for 2.25 s where the charged bolt burst: 6 inside 0.5 units to 2 at 1.5, at the latest-gen fire type's x0.25 on shields and x0.75 on the body (1.5 and 4.5 a pulse: about 40 to a bare player who stands in it); the source's pool numbers are not read: these are AE's

the charged burst and its pool: CMT's devourer impact effect (a burst, then nine burning pulses 0.25 s apart with their flames), its damage the ravager's: the nearest CE has to the latest-gen lingering plasma pool (a fixed spot burning for 2.25 s)

expected.about: the first build of the recipe (2026-11-04, revision 1, look B3-trim); re-pinned 2026-11-04 for the latest-gen setup tuned for CE and look B3bd (owner's picks), built twice (a, b) with the same result; re-pinned 2026-11-04 for the engine's paced burst (behaviour 5, revision 2: one bolt a shot, the RAVAGER profile); re-pinned for the pack's HUD without its own panel (the map's stock panel is the child HUD); a pack built twice from the recipe was the same
